scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/renderRules.mjs --emulator && npx --yes firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore --project argus-rules-test "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.rules:deploy: node scripts/renderRules.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:rules
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
scripts.build:e2e: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY= VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN= VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID= VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID= VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET= VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID= VITE_ARGUS_INBOX_UID= npm run build
